Size.figmaMatrixNote: Figma Button component set currently ships 4 text sizes (Default, Extra Small, Small, Large) × 6 appearances. Icon-only sizes exist in code; extend the Figma matrix when icon-only button variants are added.

Slot start.note: Leading icon slot (max 1 child). Toggle with Show slot start.

Slot end.note: Trailing icon slot (max 1 child). Toggle with Show slot end.

Button.figmaMatrixNote: 24 variants (6 Appearance × 4 Size). Slot wrappers: HORIZONTAL, HUG×HUG, centered, clipsContent true, bound to Show slot start/end. Slot nodes: HUG×FIXED square per size (16/16/20/24 px). Child order: Slot start wrapper → Button label → Slot end wrapper. Reference layout: node 554:266 (Link, Large).

Size.note: Numeric labels match Phosphor Icon size prop (12, 16, 20, 24, 32).

Badge.figmaMatrixNote: 60 variants (15 accents × 4 appearances). Default pill shape. Size/Shape are separate code props; add auxiliary Figma sets if needed.

State.note: Radix accordion item open/closed; Figma State=Open maps to expanded trigger.
Open preview with overlay + content (portal state).

Alert Dialog.figmaMatrixNote: 720×520 viewport. Overlay uds/scrim/50. Default 400px + Red pastel medallion 40px; Small 320px + Amber. Header left-aligned p-16; footer uds/surface/tertiary with Outline Cancel + Default Continue.

Tabs.note: Figma variant axis 2–6; not a code prop — pick variant matching desired tab count in mockups.

Active.note: Numeric 1–n where n = Tabs count. Maps to active tab index in list.

Tabs.figmaMatrixNote: 80 variants. Fill=false (hug) | Fill=true (full width). Pill list: uds/surface/secondary, radius-6, active uds/surface/brand-quaternary + inverse text. Line: border-primary bottom, active uds/text/brand-quaternary + 2px indicator.

Menu.note: Compose package Menu in slot `slot / menu`. Maps to AppShell.Menu / props.menu.

Listview.note: Maps to AppShell.Listview / props.listview. Includes `slot / listview-scroll`.

Footer.note: Maps to AppShell.Footer / props.footer (scrolls with main).

AppShell.figmaMatrixNote: 8 variants (Menu × Listview × Footer). Slots: slot/menu, slot/header (+ slot/header-trailing), slot/listview (+ listview-scroll), slot/main, slot/footer. DOM mirrors appshell--* regions. Header always on; maps AppShell.Header → Header trailing. 1280×800 preview.

Alert.figmaMatrixNote: HUG flex row items-start gap-12 p-16. Medallion 40px: Sky (default), Red (destructive), Yellow (warning), Green (success), all Pastel. Title Body/16/Semibold; description Body/14/Regular. Default: border secondary, title primary, description secondary. Destructive: button destructive border + copy. Warning: system/warning primary border + copy. Success: system/constructive primary border + copy.

Appearance.note: Initials = AvatarFallback on uds/color/primary/700. Any other Appearance value is a doctor portrait stem from DOCTOR_AVATAR_IDS (public/avatars/doctors/*.png).

Accessory.note: Mutually exclusive: None, Status (nested exposed DotStatus), or Camera. Status hue is not a variant axis — change nested DotStatus Variant on the instance.

DotStatus Variant.note: Exposed nested instance property on Avatar status (maps to DotStatus Variant). Not an Avatar variant axis.

Avatar.figmaMatrixNote: 276 variants (23 Appearances × 4 Sizes × 3 Accessories: None | Status | Camera). Status: 10×10 DotStatus (Variant=Green default), positioned xs +1px / sm+default −1px / lg −4px from bottom-right (matches code AvatarStatus). Camera: xs 16×16 +8px icon +6px offset / sm+default 20×20 +12px +8px / lg 24×24 +16px +4px past corner; neutrals-300 fill, 2px surface ring, regular Camera icon. Accessories use clipsContent false. Status hue via exposed DotStatus Variant, not an Avatar axis.

Branding.figmaMatrixNote: 16 variants (8 appearances × Symbol). SVG from public/branding/svg. CHG and Design System share unified-design-system assets. Build: scripts/figma-run-branding-batches.mjs + use_figma on branding-batches/*.js.

Medallion.figmaMatrixNote: 36 variants (18 colors × 2 tones). Default circle shape at 40px. Size and Shape are code-only unless Medallion / Layout set is built.
